description: Repair select_latest(records) to deduplicate checkpoint records while preserving identities, chronological semantics and stable output order.
requirements: Input is a list of dicts. Identity is the exact pair (project, run_id), not run_id alone. Skip rows whose project or run_id is missing, not a string, empty or whitespace-only; do not strip valid identity values.
For each identity prefer the record with latest valid timezone-aware ISO-8601 updated_at instant. Z and numeric UTC offsets are supported. Compare instants, not the timestamp text.
Missing, malformed, non-string or timezone-naive updated_at values are invalid. A valid timestamp beats every invalid timestamp.
When valid timestamps represent equal instants, choose the later input occurrence. When all timestamps for a key are invalid, choose the later input occurrence.
Output one original-content record per valid identity, ordered by when that identity first appeared in the input, irrespective of which occurrence wins.
Do not mutate input records or the input list. Additional record fields must be preserved.

provenance.description: Inspired by run-ledger deduplication in tools/ledger/ingest.py. This explicit latest-checkpoint policy is a constructed extension, not a claim about the intended semantics of that existing script. No source code was copied.

validity_limits: Calibration only; these tasks do not establish representative development performance or generality.
Hidden tests are independent of the solving run, not independently authored from this fixture's reference implementation.
The oracle is one valid implementation, not an exact patch requirement; behavioral alternatives are allowed.
Passing visible tests is intentionally insufficient. Base failure is seeded and does not predict model failure rate.
